_comment: Names pinned to the daily shortlist. They are scored exactly like every other stock and are NOT given a bonus - they simply always surface, with their real score and true rank, even when they do not earn a top-20 slot. Remove a name by deleting its entry. Read by tools/build_shortlist.py, which emits them as doc.watchlist.

names.note: Ranked 1st of 8 in the chemicals-cluster comparative note. Cheapest name there at 6.3x earnings and 0.83x book, with a 48.4% operating margin that is structural (Khavda solar, near-zero marginal cost) rather than cyclical. Watching the Rs 7,000 Cr lignite decision and the Q3 FY27 500 MW commissioning.

Ranked 2nd of 8. Seven consecutive quarters of sequential revenue growth, margin +255bps - and it pre-dates the H-acid squeeze, so the thesis is optionality rather than the whole case. Watching Q2 FY27 (around November) for the eighth quarter with H-acid realisations in the numbers.

Ranked 4th of 8, just 0.2 behind Foseco - effectively tied for third, and the comparative note says to read it as a co-equal third if the preference runs to cheapness over quality. A Rs 8.2 Cr loss became a Rs 71 Cr profit with the margin swinging 1,778bps, the largest single-year move in the library. ~5.8x annualised earnings, 1.22x book. The risk is that it is a pure spread business with no control over either end. Watching the PAN-orthoxylene spread and the plasticizer plant starting commercial production in September 2026.
